entries.rule: docs/design-system.md Dynamic Type: accessibility-sized layout defects are found by screenshotting, not by reading.
entries.reason: The buy button does not truncate — it wraps. Two independent reviewers (this run's ios-reviewer, and an earlier adversarial pass that filed it CRITICAL) both inferred truncation from PrimaryButtonStyle carrying no lineLimit. SwiftUI Text wraps by default; truncation needs an explicit lineLimit(1) or a hard width constraint, and neither exists. Checked against the committed artifact rather than the code: RascalTests/__Screenshots__/paywall-settings-accessibility5.png renders 'Start the / free trial' across two lines with no ellipsis. Suppressed because two reviewers reaching it independently means a third will.
